How Serial Productions connects

  • Topic: Serial — Serial Productions produces Serial.
  • Artist: Sarah Koenig — Koenig built Serial Productions around the show.
  • Artist: Julie Snyder — Snyder built Serial Productions around the show.
  • Faction: The New York Times — The New York Times later partnered with and housed Serial Productions.

What is Serial Productions?

Serial Productions is the shop Koenig and Snyder built around the show, later in partnership with the New York Times, still the banner on Serial seasons and spin-off investigations.

Key threads lead to Serial, Sarah Koenig, Julie Snyder and The New York Times.
